collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A child receives a beautifully carved spinning top, and several other children crowd around wanting a turn.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a child, receives a beautifully carved spinning top, and several other children crowd around wanting a turn.

choices.label: Teach Others How to Spin It.
Keep It Just for a Little While First.
Ask the Carver to Make More.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The top spins happily from hand to hand.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One child keeps it too long, and the others gently remind them.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Soon everyone is spinning it well.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child enjoys it alone and then shares happily.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The other children wander off, and the child calls them back to share.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The carver makes several, and the whole group plays together.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The carver is too busy, so the children try carving their own.

b2__fx.name: Outcome B2
b2__fx.text: The top keeps falling over, and the children laugh at every tumble.

b2__text.name: Outcome B2
b2__text.text: The top keeps falling over, and the children laugh at every tumble.
